thread:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock billing metadata for the AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings today. Can legal confirm acceptable billing copy for the SKU-level entitlements? @sara_legal

sara_legal: Hi — send the proposed labels/fields you plan to include. we need explicit wording for: billing cadence, refunds, and any trial/commit language. I'll loop in contracts if it becomes non-standard.

mike_aws: FYI AWS requires a meter dimension + SKU mapping. Are we doing subscription (monthly) and usage (metering) variants? need to know meter names to register with AWSMP.

jia_gcp: GCP wants the product id and whether this is BYOL or license-included. also confirm whether trial is 14/30 days so we can set the trial flag on the listing.

lina_packaging: AMI/container images are ready. I added a draft metadata manifest — missing billing fields. sample snippet below:
```json
{
  "sku": "redwood-inference-pro",
  "variants": ["subscription","usage"],
  "billing_unit": "vCPU-hour",
  "metering_dimension": "tokens_processed",
  "trial_days": 14,
  "license_type": "included"
}
```
Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-metadata/pull/42

ben_bizops: Suggest pricing tiers: dev (free-tier), team ($/mo), enterprise (commit pricing). For usage variant map meter to 1 token = 0.0001 USD; trial 14 days. Finance needs a rounded unit price for USD/EUR/GBP.

tara_marketing: We also need short marketing copy for each SKU variant and a trial badge asset. I can draft copy once legal okays the trial wording.

sara_legal: Draft approved language for metadata: "Usage-based commit billed monthly in arrears. Customers may cancel at any time; refunds are case-by-case and per contract. Trial periods are limited to one per account. Purchase is subject to Redwood Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum." This wording is fine for listing copy and metadata fields.

alex: Great — can we commit these fields today? @deploy-bot can you run the marketplace metadata linter on the PR? want to catch schema mismatches before we submit.

deploy-bot: marketplace-metadata-lint: running against PR #42...

deploy-bot: marketplace-metadata-lint: ERROR: missing "subscription_term" field for subscription variant. see https://internal.redwood.dev/marketplace-schema

lina_packaging: Thanks — updated PR with subscription_term = "P1M" and added meter names matching AWS/GCP requirements. pushed.

mike_aws: Also confirm IAM role for listing automation: we need the role with policy action `aws-marketplace:Subscribe` and image access to the AMI account. minimal policy example: `{"Action": ["aws-marketplace:Subscribe"], "Resource": ["*"]}` (we'll tighten).

jia_gcp: For GCP I added the mapping doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/gcp-marketplace/sku-mapping. Need product_id from platform team to publish.

ben_bizops: Finance confirmed rounding rules; will create billing product in Stripe mirror once SKUs are final. I'll add currency mapping in the same PR.

sara_legal: Approved final metadata fields and copy for submission. minor note: ensure refund policy appears in listing detail pages exactly as above.

alex: Awesome — locking this. final checklist: legal copy ✅, PR updated ✅, linter pass ✅, AWS/GCP role & product ids pending (mike/jia), marketing assets pending (tara). target submit by EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: marketplace-metadata-lint: PASS on PR #42 — all schema checks green.

tara_marketing: I'll upload trial badge and two short descriptions by noon, then we can go live once partner portals accept the packages.

lina_packaging: Merged PR #42 -> main. publishing pipeline will start after partner role confirmations.

mike_aws: I'll follow up on AMI permissions with infra; should have role ARN in the next hour.

jia_gcp: I'll request product_id from GCP marketplace team and post here when available.

ben_bizops: tagging finance @finance — please prepare the SKU mapping for billing mirror.

sara_legal: noted. closing my loop.

alex: Thanks everyone — holding submit window till 17:00 PT. ping here if anything blocks.
